chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Sulayman al-Mustarriq, from Salih al-Ahwal, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established brotherhood between Salman and Abu Dharr, and stipulated upon Abu Dharr that he would not disobey Salman.'
ai.seo_question: What condition did the Prophet place on Abu Dharr regarding his relationship with Salman?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) establishment of brotherhood between Salman al-Farsi and Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, with a specific condition that Abu Dharr not disobey Salman. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted as recognizing Salman’s superior knowledge or status, particularly given his Persian origin and deep understanding of Islamic sciences, thereby elevating him above the Arab companion Abu Dharr in certain respects. The condition underscores the importance of respecting those with greater religious insight, even if they are from different ethnic backgrounds.

en.hubeali: H 14616 – Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al-Abbas, from Suleyman Al-Musattaq, from Saleh Al-Howl who said:

I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The Rasoolsaww established brotherhood between Salmanar and Abu Dharrar, and stipulated a condition upon Abu Dharrar that hear would not disobey Salmanar (as a younger to an elder brother).
en.sarwar: 168. Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al-Abbas, from Suleyman Al-Musattaq, from Saleh Al-Howl who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s.) saying: ‘The Rasool (saww) established brotherhood between Salman (ar) and Abu Dharr (ar), and stipulated a condition upon Abu Dharr (ar) that he (ar) would not disobey Salman (ar) (as a younger to an elder brother).
